text: Since July 2023, CreateTO, Corporate Real Estate Management (CREM), Toronto Shelter and Support Services (TSSS) and the Indigenous Affairs Office have worked collaboratively with the 2-Spirited People of the 1st Nations ("2-Spirits") in identifying potential sites for Toronto's first purpose built emergency shelter for 2SLGBTQIA+ Indigenous individuals seeking shelter or fleeing violence. The City-owned property at 996 Woodbine Avenue (the "Property") has been identified as the preferred site, and 2-Spirits is proposing to construct and operate an 11-bed emergency shelter to meet the unique needs of Toronto's 2SLGBTQIA+ Indigenous community. The proposed emergency shelter includes an integrated transitional housing component, as well as 24/7/365 onsite staff to provide culturally appropriate supports.
